description: PENDING (not loaded by default; ontology.schema load_schema(include_pending=True)). The Portal warehouse (app_warehouse) and its BC locations: Location Code = upper(app_warehouse.code), a lead (no BC company on the Portal row; BC_WAREHOUSE_LOCATION_MAP may remap a code). Replaces the Warehouse placeholder of domains/bc_bridge.json when loaded; the Portal warehouse_id foreign keys become links to it (ontology/schema.py pending_links).

object_types.description: Portal warehouse (app_warehouse), pending: bound and tested ahead of the upstream ask Q3; its code is the BC Location Code (Warehouse.bc_location). Moves to domains/bc_bridge.json, replacing the placeholder there, when the reporting API serves it.

properties.name: code

properties.name: exclude_from_valuation
properties.description: 3PL / consignment site: customer-owned stock posted to BC at $0.

link_types.name: bc_location
link_types.description: The BC location of each company whose Location Code is this warehouse's code (upper-cased, as the Portal posts it). A lead: the Portal row names no BC company (one code names a location in every company holding it) and BC_WAREHOUSE_LOCATION_MAP can remap a code.

portal.warehouse_model.note: model Warehouse @@map("app_warehouse"): id cuid PK; name and code unique (the Sage / ERP site code); location_type, exclude_from_valuation, is_active.

portal.bc_location_code.note: resolveBcLocationCode(warehouseCode): trim + upper-case, then the optional BC_WAREHOUSE_LOCATION_MAP remap; the BC locationCode the Portal posts (three-pl-intake-sync.ts: locationCode = Warehouse.code).
